Calculator Tech Roles Talent Hubs Kit sales paused
Hiring kit sales paused — November 14, 2026. The package advertised 25 jurisdictions but contained notes for six countries, and its contract examples have not received local legal review. We have stopped new sales. Existing purchasers can use their Gumroad receipt for downloads or support. Do not treat the examples as validated legal agreements. Reopening requires corrected scope, sources, professional review and user task testing.
How estimates work: annual pay = a manually selected US role baseline × a fixed country multiplier. Monthly pay = annual pay ÷ 12; hourly pay = annual pay ÷ 2,080. These are illustrative USD budgets, not survey results or current job offers. Tax and contractor notes are simplified references, not legal determinations.
